## Description

A degenerate edge bridges a singular row that is shared by adjacent faces; translator processes it once per face, building it again with potentially divergent vertex tolerance.

## Reproducer recipe

Two faces both touching a sphere pole, sharing a degenerate edge along the pole; observe duplicated `EDGE_CURVE` instances in OCCT topology.

## Expected kernel behavior

cache and reuse the translated degenerate edge across faces.

## Notes

A translator with a per-face entity cache reuses the same edge across faces; one without translates each occurrence independently. **See also**: Twi031.
